elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 28.1 expressly states that the Agreement is governed exclusively by New York law.

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
elements.evidence: Section 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to state and federal courts in New York County, with only a carve-out for temporary injunctive relief in another court to protect confidential information or intellectual property.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: Section 28.1 selects New York law, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales law.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: Section 28.2 selects state and federal courts in New York County, not Delaware, California, or London courts.
